title: QuadPay.Gateway.Orders.Commands.CaptureOrder+Command
description: Used to capture the funds on an order that is denoted as deferred fund capture/pay-on-ship.

orderId.description: Gets or sets the Id of the Order.

currency.description: Gets or sets the Currency of the capture.

amount.description: Gets or sets the Amount of the capture.

merchantReference.description: Gets or sets the Merchant Reference of the capture.

merchantPlatformId.description: Gets or sets the Merchant Platform ID of the capture.

singleCapture.description:
Gets or sets a value indicating whether or not the order will only be captured once.
In that case if the capture value is less than the order value, the remainder will be voided.

callbackUrl.description: Gets or sets the url to callback with the capture result.

test.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether this is a test order.

metadata.description: Gets or sets optional metadata associated with this capture.

isSync.description: Get or sets a flag indicating whether or not to invoke this operation synchronously. Set to false by default.
